task.title: Restoring the Red Hat Quay object storage data
task.shortdesc: To restore your Red Hat Quay object storage data from a backup, you can export AWS credentials from secrets and use the aws s3 sync command to upload blobs to your storage bucket. This procedure restores your registry’s object storage data using backup files.

note.p: You can also use rclone or sc3md instead of the AWS command line utility.

step.cmd: Export the AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID by entering the following command:
Export the AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY by entering the following command:
Upload all blobs to the bucket by running the following command:

info.codeblock: $ aws s3 sync --no-verify-ssl --endpoint https://$(oc get route s3 -n openshift-storage -o jsonpath='{.spec.host}') ./blobs s3://$(oc get cm -l app=noobaa -n <quay-namespace> -o jsonpath='{.items[0].data.BUCKET_NAME}')
